title: The vendor licences the player agreed to in the launcher (<data>/state/vendor-licenses.json), format 1
description: Written by the launcher (kiln_manage::vendor::agreements) when the player clicks "I agree, download" in the licence dialog of a vendor component. Per vendor, every licence text agreed to, by the SHA-256 of the text: a component whose licence hash is not listed shows the dialog again (a changed text asks again). The launcher's own state, not the game's: the player agrees once on this PC, nothing in the game needs it, and a game folder (or its kiln.json, which the game and other tools write) is no place for a record of the player's consent. Losing the file only means the dialog comes again. docs/kiln/launcher/contracts.md, "Vendor files".

license.description: The licence's name as the dialog showed it.

component.description: The component whose dialog it was.
